name: Dumbbell fly

phases.name: open
phases.cue: Open your arms wide in an arc

phases.name: stretch
phases.cue: Feel the stretch at chest level

phases.name: squeeze
phases.cue: Squeeze your chest at the top

formTips: Lie flat with your feet planted and the dumbbells together over your chest, palms facing
Keep a soft, fixed bend in your elbows the whole rep
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until the dumbbells are about level with your chest
Bring them back up the same arc, as if hugging a big tree
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your back on the bench
commonMistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows, which turns it into a press
Lowering the dumbbells far below the chest and straining the shoulders
Going too heavy and dropping into the bottom
Banging the dumbbells together at the top
